desc: 粉紫梦幻展台配香槟金精华液，白底主图、金滴微距、成分信息图与双瓶收口
name: 香槟金瓶水感精华液款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底首图
一秒传达水润轻盈的核心利益，承接主图点击
用悬浮金滴微距证明质地通透细腻
代入清晨梳妆台真实使用情境，营造松弛氛围
用分子球信息图讲清成分来源故事，建立专业感
放大洁后干燥紧绷的不适，引出产品抚慰的一侧
用留空的凭证占位降风险，把背书交给后续实拍合成
以双瓶组合收口促单，留出收尾文案位

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft lilac #DCD3F0 and blush pink #F6D9DE pastel fields with rounded podium props for info, scene and closing shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and slim-stroke molecule spheres in champagne gold #D2A96E only
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio light, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy pastel skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft lilac #DCD3F0, blush pink #F6D9DE, deep violet-grey text #4E4666 and one champagne gold accent #D2A96E; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line icons and slim-stroke molecule spheres in champagne gold only; clean high-end serum photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the bottle across the set, centered and upright
style.surfaceSystem: matte pastel podium discs and frosted glass-look panels
